title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 004
review_goal: Differentiate the next five MingCute home variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.ambiguity_note: Do not use when another home variant includes a visible doorway circular window or angled roof overhangs.
